asks: Shall I put you down as collecting, or as forgetting?
What did you come in here holding?
description: A book the size of a door lies open on a stand that wasn't there, and it's keeping a list. Every item anybody has ever put down in this room is in it, in a hand that changes with the century.
emotes: A page turns itself, {it} makes a small note, and turns back.
{it} underlines something and looks pleased about it.
The stand under {it} adjusts its height, politely, to yours.
looks: The current page is today. Your own name is on it, twice, and you have only put down one thing.
Earlier entries are in languages the room has forgotten. The handwriting gets better going back.
There's a column for what was left and a column for whether it was collected. The second column is mostly empty.
name: a ledger of everything left here
says: Nothing is ever really lost. It's filed.
You'd be amazed what people walk away from.
I don't judge. I just record.
